orgEncryptionTab.intro: The encryption key this organization's data is wrapped under. You can set, replace and rotate it here. Nothing on this deployment can display it to you or to anyone else.
orgEncryptionTab.unset: This organization has not set a key of its own. Its data is wrapped under the deployment's key.
orgEncryptionTab.modeGenerate: Generate one. It exists only in the ring and is shown to nobody.
orgEncryptionTab.keyHelp: Base64 of 32 random bytes, e.g. openssl rand -base64 32. It is written once and never read back.
orgEncryptionTab.rotationNote: Rotating changes the key new data is wrapped under. The previous key is retired into the ring and still decrypts what it wrote, so existing data stays readable, and a rotation is not a revocation.
